lessons_used: Reordering sign-in steps and changing finish layouts consistently hurt performance across tests.
Adoption new screens, choose-path hints, and choose-path redesigns proved helpful by producing winning tests.
Adoption copy, home redesign, home wait-info, sign-in hints, and sign-in redesign showed no clear effect across tests.
Predictions were generally too high across most tests, though pessimistic negative predictions were sometimes inaccurate for winning tests.

Evidence remains thin for kinds of change tested only once (adoption hint, adoption new_flow, adoption redesign, choose_path layout, finish incentive, finish new_flow, finish notification, home new_flow, and home new_screen).

candidates.title: adoption_care_pledge_new_screen
candidates.change: Insert a new pet care pledge screen before adoption certificate where users confirm their commitment to their new pet.
candidates.why: Adoption has a 62.4% conversion rate and high completion times; introducing an explicit pledge step builds emotional connection and intent.

new_care_pledge.headline: Take the Pet Care Pledge
new_care_pledge.body: Promise to interact with and care for your desktop companion.

guard.reason: new screens need an _order that places them

candidates.title: choose_path_interactive_quiz_flow
candidates.change: Replace static selection on choose_path with a split-screen interactive personality preview flow.
candidates.why: Choose path drop-off is 19.8% with a long tail mean time of 514s; structured interactive cards speed up choice clarity.

guard.reason: Choosing a companion vibe removes the required choice between adopting and making your own.

candidates.title: pick_friend_spotlight_redesign
candidates.change: Redesign pick_friend screen using a focused spotlight layout highlighting pet animations.
candidates.why: Adoption step drops conversion down to 62.4%; a spotlight presentation makes pet choices significantly more engaging.

guard.reason: Redesigning the pick_friend layout with a spotlight view preserves its core function.

candidates.score_note: Adoption redesigns previously showed negative lift (-3.5%) and require major layout changes.

candidates.title: waiting_desktop_readiness_new_screen
candidates.change: Add a new screen before waiting that verifies desktop overlay readiness and window permissions.
candidates.why: Support mail logged 3 reports of pets failing to open on desktop or app stalling before home transition.

new_desktop_readiness.headline: Verifying Desktop Readiness
new_desktop_readiness.body: Checking screen overlay permissions so your pet displays seamlessly.

guard.reason: new screens need an _order that places them

candidates.title: story_completion_time_hint
candidates.change: Add an onboarding duration hint on the story screen promising setup in under 2 minutes.
candidates.why: Mean time spent on choose_path is 514s; setting quick time expectations up front reduces early abandonment.

guard.reason: Adding a simple duration hint to the story screen is allowed.

candidates.score_note: Choose-path hints are proven winners (+1.7%) and can be implemented as simple copy/config changes.

candidates.title: sign_in_device_sync_notification
candidates.change: Add an account sync notification banner on sign_in explaining account safety across reinstalls.
candidates.why: Support received 8 emails regarding lost or reset pets upon signing in again.

sign_in.hint: Sign in to keep your pet data safe across reinstalls and device switches.

guard.reason: Adding an account sync informational banner on the sign-in screen is allowed.

candidates.score_note: Strong support evidence (8 tickets) combined with funnel drop, though sign-in modifications have mixed historical lift.

candidates.title: adoption_certificate_mascot_incentive
candidates.change: Display a celebratory mascot badge on the adoption certificate screen to mark completion.
candidates.why: Adoption is a critical drop-off point (62.4% conversion); celebrating the milestone boosts progression into home.

guard.reason: Replacing the certificate components with a mascot badge loses the required official stamp.

candidates.title: waiting_tip_carousel_wait_info
candidates.change: Add a tip carousel on the waiting screen explaining how to interact with the pet.
candidates.why: Median wait time is 201s and support received 3 tickets asking how to control, hide, or talk to the pet after onboarding.

components.text: Tip: Right-click your pet to access settings anytime!

guard.reason: Adding a tip carousel to the waiting screen is explicitly allowed under Rule 4.

candidates.score_note: Home wait-info changes consistently delivered positive lift (+1.2% over 3 tests) and address active support tickets.

candidates.title: home_intro_desktop_controls_copy
candidates.change: Update copy on home_intro screen to clearly detail desktop movement and pet visibility shortcuts.
candidates.why: Multiple support emails cited confusion about controlling, hiding, or summoning the pet after completing setup.

home_intro.headline: Your Pet is Live on Your Desktop!
home_intro.body: Click and drag to position your pet. Right-click to access controls, mute sound, or hide.

guard.reason: Updating copy on the home_intro overlay is allowed as part of onboarding.

candidates.score_note: Text copy update is low-cost (config only) and directly addresses post-onboarding confusion mentioned in support emails.

candidates.title: sign_in_choice_cards_redesign
candidates.change: Redesign the sign-in screen with a centered layout and bold choice cards for single-click auth.
candidates.why: Sign-in conversion sits at 72.9% and support reported instances of sign-in screen stalling.

guard.reason: Redesigning the sign-in screen layout while retaining sign-in functionality is allowed.

candidates.score_note: Sign-in redesigns averaged negative performance (-1.1%) across past tests and require full layout changes.

lessons_next: Reordering sign-in steps and changing finish layouts consistently hurt performance across tests.
Adoption new screens proved helpful by producing winning tests with consistent positive direction.
Adoption copy, home redesign, home wait-info, sign-in hints, and sign-in redesign showed no clear effect across tests.
Predictions were generally too high overall, though pessimistic negative predictions were too low for winning tests.

Evidence remains thin for kinds of change tested only once or without clear agreement across tests (such as adoption hint, adoption new_flow, choose_path layout, finish copy, finish incentive, finish new_flow, finish notification, home new_flow, and home new_screen).
